entries.zh: 肿；胀（身体肿胀、鼓起）
entries.en: to swell, puff up; to become bloated (hincharse)
entries.notes: R 栏对音“ball/bull”存疑且不似官话音，释义依 L“Hincharse”、H“脹”与 M 栏三栏互证

entries.zh: 肿；肿胀（兼指肿块，即 hinchazón）
entries.en: swollen; a swelling (hinchazón)

entries.zh: 肿起来
entries.en: to swell up
entries.notes: H 末字“未/來”存疑，据 M 栏 lāy 判读为“來”，取“肿起来”义

entries.zh: 凸起；鼓胀（如面包发酵般鼓起发泡）
entries.en: to bulge out; to swell like leavened, foaming bread
entries.notes: M 栏“chín sōg. cuça ut agua”难解，释义依 L“如面包般鼓起、发泡”与 H“凸”

entries.zh: 齿肿；牙床肿起
entries.en: swollen teeth or gums (the teeth swell)
entries.notes: H 第二字“痱/瘡”存疑且与 M 栏对音不合，依 L“los dientes”定为齿肿

entries.zh: 肿起；臃肿鼓起
entries.en: to swell up, puff out
entries.notes: L 第二词“abrostate”难解，H 首字“㗙/咄”存疑；“腫”明确，义依“肿起”定

entries.zh: 肿胀；疔疮发作肿起（疑指脓肿）
entries.en: a swelling; eruption of a boil or abscess (hinchazón)
entries.notes: L“deposinema”难解（疑为 apostema 脓肿之讹写），H 末字“癘/瘍”存疑；义依 hinchaçon 与“疔發”

entries.zh: 涨；鼓起（如面发酵鼓起，水涨亦同）
entries.en: to swell, rise (as bread when it leavens; of water, to rise)

entries.zh: 发起（面团）；增隆〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to raise/leaven (dough); to swell up [entry partly defective; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: M 第三音节污损难辨（T99），L“masyma”疑为 masa（面团）之讹写；“发起/增隆”义系推断

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [Entry defective; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 仅 L 栏可读且自含存疑（疑义为填塞土地空处），H/R 两栏空白、M 栏难辨

entries.zh: 伪君子；虚伪之人
entries.en: hypocrite; dissembler
entries.notes: H 后二字“消胯/膀”存疑难解，依 L“Hipocrita”与首字“假”（假装义）定释义

entries.zh: 伪君子；外表不实之人
entries.en: hypocrite; one false in outward show
entries.notes: H“外未”字面与“伪善”之义合需推断（外＝外表虚饰），故降置信

entries.zh: 伪君子；徒有仁义虚名者
entries.en: hypocrite; one having the name but not the substance of virtue
entries.notes: H 末字“未/末”存疑，义依 L“hipocrita”与“仁義”徒具虚名之解推断

entries.zh: 伪君子；假好心者（装作好心之人）
entries.en: hypocrite; one who feigns good will (a counterfeit good heart)

entries.zh: 事；故事；事迹
entries.en: history; story; account of deeds
entries.notes: H“事/孛”存疑，且 M 栏三音节与单字“事”不合（疑含“故事”等词），释义依 L“Historia”

entries.zh: 史；历史；史书
entries.en: history; historical records

entries.zh: 传；传记（记述往事故实之文）
entries.en: a chronicle or biography (zhuan); an account handed down
entries.notes: M 栏后半（di-latari ut fare 以下）夹混西语难解，依 L“historia”与 H“傳”定释义

entries.zh: 鉴；史鉴（如《通鉴》之“鉴”，以史为镜的史籍）
entries.en: a mirror; historical mirror/annals (as in the T'ung-chien), i.e. history

entries.zh: 传世；（史事）流传后世
entries.en: handed down to later ages; transmitted to posterity

entries.zh: 史记；史籍（《史记》，太史公之史书）
entries.en: the Shiji, Records of the Grand Historian; a historical classic
entries.notes: M 栏“a lexia. gī liog”难解，“史记”义依 L 与 M 栏前两音节（sû-gúy）
